nodes.label: Module 7 — Care Plan (IPOC)
nodes.rationale: Owns the Individualized Plan of Care surveyors inspect most directly; competitors ship a flat problem list with a free-text plan field and an IDG-review checkbox that enforces no content, producing the two classic citations of review-without-revision and clinical-only goals.

nodes.label: Hybrid Versioning: mutable rows + immutable state_snapshot (D1)
nodes.rationale: A surveyor asking 'what was the plan on day N' gets a deterministic answer from the snapshot while the clinician hot path stays on mutable rows. Per-version row duplication would balloon storage and complicate edit ergonomics; mutable-rows-plus-audit-only loses point-in-time fidelity to a survey-grade standard.

nodes.label: CARE_PLAN_GATES — 5-day initial and 15-day review encounter-sign gates (D2, D3)
nodes.rationale: The gate is on encounter signing, not chart access — a clinician can always read and document; the system blocks committing the visit. A hard gate at day 15 would trigger constant overrides on weekend-overlapping cycles, so a 3-day grace plus an audited override keeps a real agency moving without surrendering enforcement.

nodes.label: RequiredSignerSet Quorum Constants (D5)
nodes.rationale: Capturing the required signer set at version-open time rather than evaluating at sign time makes survey reconstruction deterministic. The IDG physician seat is MD/DO only per ADR-0018 D3 — an NP may sign the INITIAL plan as attending but may not occupy the CoP 418.56 IDG physician role.

nodes.label: IdgDecisionPayload Outbox Seam (D4)
nodes.rationale: Even though the dependency direction permits M14 to call applyIdgDecision directly, the outbox is the canonical wire so a meeting decision never silently disappears under retries; the recovery story is M1's dispatcher, not a bespoke retry in M14, and a single typed payload prevents shape drift.

nodes.label: Patient-Stated Goal Verbatim Preservation (D6)
nodes.rationale: original_text is NOT NULL and immutable after creation via CHECK constraint, service guard and audit trigger — direct schema-level enforcement of the CoP 418.56(c) patient-and-family-goals rule, discoverable in survey without relying on a clinician convention.

nodes.label: Single Consent Seam to M39 with sud_disclosure_allowed / dpoa_active predicates (D7)
nodes.rationale: One seam, one consent query, two predicates: M39 owns consent state, M3 owns ABAC mechanics, M7 owns the predicates' meaning for care-plan content. SUD redaction is applied as a SQL WHERE filter, never post-fetch, so there is no 'data loaded but UI-hidden' risk.
